body: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
plain_description: **Give your team one place to use AI models.** Connect local models through Ollama or use OpenAI-compatible APIs for local and cloud models. Run it on your own setup, including offline.
technical_description: Open WebUI is an extensible, self-hosted AI platform that runs entirely offline. It connects to local models through Ollama and to local or cloud models through OpenAI-compatible APIs. The README documents Python and Docker installation, a native desktop app, and Kubernetes deployment guidance.
title: Open WebUI
